info.totalUsers: Users that existed at the end of the range, not counting deleted ones.
info.newUsers: Accounts created in the range, including ones deleted afterwards.
info.activeUsers: Different users who signed in during the range.
info.activeUsersLastLogin: Users whose latest sign-in falls in the range. Earlier sign-ins are overwritten by later ones, so past ranges are approximate.
info.failedLogins: Approximate: repeated anonymous failures are sampled.

kpi.vsPreviousProgress: vs same point of previous {{days}} days

trend.title: Sign-in trend
trend.failedApprox: Failed sign-ins are approximate: repeated anonymous failures are sampled.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.lockedUsersHint: Locked after repeated failed sign-ins or by an administrator
attention.adminsWithoutTwoFactorHint: Turn it on for accounts with elevated access
attention.unconfirmedEmailUsersHint: They can't receive password reset emails
attention.disabledTenantsHint: Users of a disabled tenant can't sign in
